baselines.note: No public benchmark measures an agent-harness control plane (scheduling runs of headless CLI agents onto pull-based workers), so there is no published score to compare against. The closest public data, the Azure Functions and Alibaba cluster traces, are workloads without an oracle; see BENCHMARKING.md, Datasets.

notes: Finite equal-weight tenant workload: noisy tenant receives 100 times each quiet tenant's submissions. Runs are interleaved in rounds. Server queueMs, not client admission delay, determines fairness. Quiet p95 target 10000 ms. No claim of steady-state fairness or a universal production latency target.

Invocation wait mode: True; asynchronous mode uses bulk tenant completion reads every 500 ms instead of a waiting HTTP request per run. QueueMs comes from server timestamps. Admission latency is reported separately.
Replica endpoints: http://127.0.0.1:37800. Restarting replicas resets their local virtual service history.
Stage counter deltas are from the first replica only; multi-replica queue percentiles still include all submitted runs.
